company.shortDescription: Freshworks is building and delivering online cloud-based software-as-a-service that provides helpdesk support with automation solutions.
company.description:
Freshworks provides innovative customer engagement software for businesses of all sizes, making it easy for teams to acquire, close, and keep their customers for life. Freshworks SaaS products provide a 360-degree view of the customer are ready to go, easy to use and oﬀer quick return on investment. 

It was founded in 2010 and Headquartered in San Mateo, USA.

aiResearchSummary.text: Freshworks is researching and developing cloud-based solutions for helpdesk automation, focusing on predicting customer churn from multi-product data using sequential deep learning models, processing user queries for virtual agents by identifying user intents, managing connections in multi-tenancy computing environments, extracting key-value information from unstructured data, optimizing lead pooling and ranking with machine learning, and incremental clustering of messages to enhance scalability. These areas reflect advancements in automation and intelligent support systems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
